# cursor_private_workers_summary (Data Source)

Reads connected and in-use private worker counts for the authenticated user and their team, with the provider pool_api_key. The counts change as workers connect and take work, so a value read during plan can differ at apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_private_workers_summary" "current" {}

output "team_workers_connected" {
  # Null when the key has no team summary.
  value = data.cursor_private_workers_summary.current.team_total_connected
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) summary.
- `team_in_use` (Number) Connected team workers that have an assigned agent. Null when the API returns no team summary.
- `team_total_connected` (Number) Workers connected to the team's pools. Null when the API returns no team summary.
- `user_in_use` (Number) Connected user workers that have an assigned agent. Null when the API returns no user summary.
- `user_total_connected` (Number) Workers connected to the user's pools. Null when the API returns no user summary.
